CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at [www.coreweave.com](http://www.coreweave.com/).

## What You’ll Do

The Strategy and Transformation team builds intelligent systems and first-party applications that improve how CoreWeave’s internal teams work. The team partners with Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and core business operations to connect workflows across enterprise platforms, including ERP, HRIS, MRP, PDM, and DCIM.

## About the Role

As a Software and AI Engineer, IT Systems, you’ll design and build AI agents, copilots, and first-party applications that make CoreWeave’s internal workflows more intelligent, automated, and intuitive. You’ll work across applied AI, product design, and full-stack engineering—from agentic workflows built with integration platforms and AI frameworks to React interfaces and backend services in Node.js and Go.

In this role, you will:

* Develop AI agents and copilots for Finance, Billing, Supply Chain, and other internal teams, using frameworks and APIs such as LangChain, LangGraph, Cohere, OpenAI, Gemini, and Glean.
* Design and build first-party web and mobile applications using React, TypeScript, and modern front-end frameworks.
* Develop scalable backend services in Node.js and Go for data processing, orchestration, and automation.
* Integrate enterprise systems—including ERP, HRIS, MRP, PDM, DCIM, and data warehouses—through native integrations or iPaaS platforms such as Workato or Boomi.
* Build APIs and microservices that support modular, event-driven application architectures.
* Use GenAI development tools such as Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT Codex to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation.
* Build observability, maintainability, and security into applications across the stack.
* Partner with stakeholders in Finance, Accounting, Security, Engineering, and other business teams to design useful, user-centered workflows.

## Who You Are

* You have 3+ years of programming experience in C++, Go, C#, Java, TypeScript, or Python, building production-grade cloud services.
* You have 3+ years of scripting experience in Python or Bash for automation and tooling.
* You have solid experience designing RESTful APIs and event-driven integration architectures.
* You have experience building and deploying production-grade applications and microservices.
* You have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container orchestration, and DevOps and CI/CD practices.
* You have experience with modern backend and frontend technologies; familiarity with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Go, FastAPI, Next.js, Kestrel, or gRPC is relevant to this role.
* You’re familiar with generative AI frameworks and APIs, such as LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, or Glean, and how they can be applied in products.
* You’re motivated by building user-facing tools that improve business productivity and employee experience.

## Preferred Skills

* Experience shipping production-grade AI, ML, or LLM-based applications at scale.
* Experience developing AI-powered or agentic applications integrated with enterprise data.
* Familiarity with machine learning and data engineering platforms such as Ray, Kafka, or Spark.
* Experience with iPaaS platforms such as Workato or Boomi.
* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, or other operational domains where intelligent automation can drive efficiency.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT Codex.
* A collaborative approach and an eye for user experience and long-term system maintainability.

**Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds—even if you don’t check every box. Here are a few qualities we’ve found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.**

* You’re curious about how AI and software can make everyday work simpler and more effective.
* You enjoy turning complex business needs into clear, approachable experiences.
* You communicate well with both technical and non-technical partners and like building solutions together.
* You balance moving quickly with building systems that are secure, maintainable, and dependable.

## Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

* Be Curious at Your Core
* Act Like an Owner
* Empower Employees
* Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
* Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $153,000 to $204,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

**What We Offer**

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

**About DAT**

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit [www.DAT.com](http://www.DAT.com)

 [](https://www.dat.com/company/news-events/news-releases/built-in-colorado-honors-dat-freight-analytics-in-its-esteemed-2023-best-places-to-work-awards?_gl=1*1f7bb2i*_ga*MTEwNjQzODc2OC4xNjcxMTQwMTMz*_ga_C36TRC5CVZ*MTY3NDc1ODM4My4xOS4xLjE2NzQ3NTg5MTYuNjAuMC4w*_ga_QYVEY2GZSM*MTY3NDc1ODM4Ni4yLjAuMTY3NDc1ODUwOC4wLjAuMA..)

* * *

**Job Application Deadline:** 01/31/2027

**The Opportunity**

As a Sr AI Engineer, you're an integral part of the team who will build and own the platform that power our agentic solutions at DAT. Freight is an uncertain business, and the models we ship reduce that uncertainty: rate forecasts, load-to-truck matching, document extraction, fraud signals, and the agentic workflows our brokers and carriers use to move freight faster. None of that reaches a customer without a platform that makes training, serving, evaluating, and monitoring models routine instead of heroic.

You'll help build the platform, from the model gateway and inference layer through feature and vector storage, evaluation harnesses, production observability, agentic framework (A2A) all on a spine based on secure access and utilization. This is a highly visible role for an engineer who wants their work multiplied across every AI team in the company.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and Ship:** Write production code for the agentic services and platform components that power DAT's agentic mesh. This powers the systems our product and engineering counterparts build from.
* **Deliver Against Specification:** Build an approved specification which includes the problem, the non-goals, the non-functional budget, the trust boundary it crosses and deliver working software against it. Flag drift between what was asked for and what you were given before you write the first line, not after.
* **Own Your Tests:** Write the test suite for what you build including unit, integration, and evals from the specification itself, not from your own implementation, so a green suite means the requirement is met, not that the code agrees with itself. Your tests and observability are what raise, or cap, the repository's autonomy ceiling.
* **Build Agentic Systems:** Build and operate agents, tools, and multi-agent workflows on DAT's agent mesh which includes tool-calling, retrieval, memory, and orchestration that run inside the entitlements resolved for the request and never reach past them.
* **AI Infrastructure on AWS:** Build and operate production AI infrastructure on AWS — Bedrock,Agent Runtime Core, Strands, Lambda, S3, etc
* **Design:** You don't own the architecture, but you do own designs built from the premise. Bring informed pushback to decisions made by the team, flag what won't hold up in production, and show up to the conversation with an opinion, not just an implementation.
* **Author Designs:** Write the high-level design (HLD) for what you build. The design, the tradeoffs you made, and why so the next engineer, and the next team, can pick it up without you in the room.
* **Review for Fidelity:** Review AI-generated and human-written changes for the systems you own, holding the line on fidelity to the spec rather than on formatting, which is already settled by code.
* **Respond to Incidents:** Carry on-call for the services you build, investigate and resolve incidents in your own systems, and turn root cause into a fix rather than a postmortem slide.
* **Publish What You Build:** Put finished skills, agents, and components into DAT's capability marketplace so the next team that needs it finds it instead of rebuilding it.

**The Skills and Experience You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with real production ownership and solutions you shipped, operated, and got paged for.
* Demonstrated experience building with LLMs and agentic frameworks in production: tool-calling, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent orchestration (e.g., LangGraph, Bedrock Agents, MCP-style tool integration) which shipped and operated, not a weekend prototype.
* Strong development skills in TypeScript/[js](http://node.js), Python, Java, or Go, with the discipline to write tests other engineers actually trust.
* Solid, hands-on AWS experience: Bedrock,Agent Core Runtime, Strands, EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, and S3 in production; working familiarity with Redpanda, MSK, or Kafka; comfortable in infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi, Terraform, or similar) even where you're not the one designing the account structure.
* Practical experience building or maintaining evaluation and monitoring for AI systems: eval sets, drift and quality signals, and treating a model regression with the same seriousness as a code regression.
* Comfortable working from a written specification rather than a verbal task. Ability to spot what's missing or ambiguous in a spec and push back before code, not after.
* Experience authoring design docs, HLDs, or short technical papers that another engineer can execute against without you there to explain it.
* Solid grounding in event-driven and distributed systems. You understand the tradeoffs Redpanda, MSK, kafka and relevant patterns force even if you're not the one drawing the topology.
* Working knowledge of observability practices — dashboards, traces, logs, and alerts sufficient to diagnose your own service and argue for what it needs to hit our authored autonomy tiers.
* Clear written and verbal communication — you'll be explaining tradeoffs to Staff and Principal engineers, to Product, and to non-technical stakeholders, not just to other engineers.

**Bonus Skills**

* Familiarity with A2A, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or comparable agent-interop patterns.
* Experience publishing to, or consuming from, an internal skill or agent registry / capability marketplace.
* Experience with model fine-tuning, distillation, or parameter-efficient training, and a clear point of view on when it beats prompting.
* Freight, logistics, or supply chain domain experience.

**Why DAT?  
**DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.

About AI & Analytics: Artificial intelligence (AI) and the data it collects and analyzes will soon sit at the core of all intelligent, human-centric businesses. By decoding customer needs, preferences, and behaviors, our clients can understand exactly what services, products, and experiences their consumers need. Within AI & Analytics, we work to design the future—a future in which trial-and-error business decisions have been replaced by informed choices and data-supported strategies.
By applying AI and data science, we help leading companies to prototype, refine, validate, and scale their AI and analytics products and delivery models. Cognizant’s AIA practice takes insights that are buried in data and provides businesses a clear way to transform how they source, interpret and consume their information. Our clients need flexible data structures and a streamlined data architecture that quickly turns data resources into informative, meaningful intelligence.
Job Summary
We are seeking a senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer to architect, build, and operationalize enterprise-scale AI systems for complex client transformation programs. This role combines hands-on engineering with enterprise AI architecture, responsible AI governance, and executive-level technical advisory. The engineer will work alongside client and delivery teams to design human-agent operating models, agentic workflows, context pipelines, and regulated AI decisioning solutions. Success will be measured by sustainable customer outcomes, production adoption, and the capability transferred to client teams.
In this role, you will:
· Design and deliver AI-native enterprise architectures spanning applications, data platforms, business processes, and cloud environments.
· Build production-grade Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, taking ownership from architecture and prototyping through deployment and operation.
· Define human-agent capability matrices, operating models, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise workflows.
· Architect context pipelines, knowledge orchestration frameworks, multi-agent systems, and cross-platform AI integrations.
· Develop guardrail specifications covering agent boundaries, tool access, data handling, autonomy, safety, and exception management.
· Establish responsible AI controls for bias detection, explainability, transparency, auditability, model risk, and regulatory compliance.

· 12–20 years of experience in enterprise technology, including significant leadership in AI architecture, solution architecture, or digital transformation.
· Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI, RAG, LLM, and agentic AI solutions in production environments.
· Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java, .NET, Python, or comparable enterprise application technologies.
· Deep understanding of multi-agent architectures, context engineering, knowledge orchestration, tool use, memory, planning, and human-agent collaboration patterns.
· Experience defining responsible AI frameworks, agent guardrails, evaluation standards, audit controls, and regulated AI decisioning models.
· Strong knowledge of cloud-native AI architecture, APIs, microservices, data platforms, DevSecOps, MLOps, AIOps, and enterprise integration patterns.
· Experience evaluating frontier models, conducting AI red-team exercises, and defining AI quality, security, performance, and safety criteria.
· Demonstrated ability to lead client architecture forums and advise executive, business, risk, and technology stakeholders.
· Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, life sciences, insurance, or government is preferred.
· Strong technical leadership, consulting, communication, stakeholder management, and business-outcome orientation.

Arm is building the foundational platform software for the next generation of Physical AI systems on Arm: software that lets AI applications and agents perceive, reason and act through real devices, reliably and on-device, across robotics, industrial automation and the smart home. The work sits at the intersection of distributed systems, edge computing and AI infrastructure.

This is a rare opportunity to join a new team in Seattle and build new products and reference implementations that enable developers to put the latest Arm technology to work in their solutions.
Job Overview: Building intelligent systems that interact with the physical world requires bringing together AI models, diverse hardware, and software frameworks across the cloud and edge. Developers need simpler ways to connect these technologies, orchestrate complex workflows, and build reliable applications that can operate across different devices and environments.

Our team is building the open-source foundations and developer tools to make Physical AI more accessible, scalable, and reliable. We are working to simplify how AI agents interact with physical devices, coordinate tasks, and operate across heterogeneous hardware environments. By bringing together AI, hardware, and developer ecosystems, we aim to make building and deploying real-world agentic applications as seamless as building software today.

As a Senior AI Engineer , you will develop the tools and technologies that bring this vision to life. You will design and build SDKs, frameworks, and reference applications that enable AI agents to interact with physical devices, orchestrate complex workflows, and operate across cloud and edge environments. You will integrate modern AI models, inference runtimes, and agent frameworks to create end-to-end applications, while developing evaluation methodologies to measure their reliability, performance, and effectiveness in real-world scenarios.

You will work hands-on with real physical hardware, and edge computing platforms, collaborating with engineers, product teams, and industry partners to shape the future of Physical AI on Arm.

Responsibilities: Design and implement features in our SDKs and reference services, on both the device side and the agent side
Build reference applications and demos that connect agents to real devices across edge and cloud, using PyTorch-ecosystem inference runtimes and popular agent frameworks
Develop evaluation harnesses that measure the reliability, latency and correctness of agent-to-device interactions, and use the results to improve the product
Bring up and maintain a fleet of development hardware (single-board computers, cameras, sensors, robot platforms, edge servers) used for development, testing and demonstrations
Contribute to the security and operational posture of the platform: identity, authorization, observability and safe failure behavior
Write clear documentation, samples and learning material for external developers, and support the open-source community through issues, reviews and contributions
Collaborate with architects, product managers and partner engineers on requirements, API design and release quality

Required Skills and Experience: Professional software engineering experience building distributed systems, with strong Python and working proficiency in at least one of C++, Rust or Go
Experience building and shipping AI-powered applications, including LLM tool use or agent frameworks, and integrating them with real systems
Practical experience deploying ML models for inference, on servers or on edge devices, with PyTorch or a comparable framework
Solid grounding in messaging, RPC, concurrency, failure handling and testing of networked software
Comfortable with Linux, embedded single-board computers, containers and CI/CD workflows
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across hardware, systems and ML disciplines
Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field

'Nice to Have' Skills and Experience: Experience with publish/subscribe messaging systems or IoT protocols
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol or similar agent-tool interfaces
Robotics or physical-AI background: ROS 2, robot arms, perception pipelines, or control loops
On-device inference experience with ExecuTorch, ONNX Runtime or vendor NPU toolchains, and LLM serving with vLLM or similar
Experience designing evaluations or benchmarks for AI agents
Contributions to open-source projects and experience supporting an external developer community
Security fundamentals for connected devices

In Return: You will take on important technical challenges in AI and platform engineering on a growing team in Seattle, and contribute to core platform capabilities that external developers use from day one. Your work will be open source and put to work in real deployments with our partners. We value thoughtful engineering, collaboration and continuous learning, and you will have a direct say in what the product becomes.

Additional Information: Please note that no relocation package is available for this role.

About the team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for ensuring the safe and effective deployment of generative AI applications for developers and enterprises. We act as a trusted advisor and thought partner for our API customers, working to build an effective backlog of frontier AI use cases for their industry and drive them to production through strong technical guidance.

As an Applied AI Engineer in the Digital Native segment, you’ll work with industry-leading technology companies like Stripe, Uber, and Reddit to bring new AI capabilities into the products their customers use every day. You’ll partner directly with experienced product and engineering teams to turn frontier model capabilities into new features and agentic experiences. The work combines rapid experimentation with the demands of established products: complex systems, real users, and high expectations for quality and performance. Lessons from these deployments inform OpenAI’s product and research teams.
